heading.zh-Hant: 出身與任總統前的官職
heading.en: Origins and offices before the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 據百科條目，基亞里1870年11月15日生，出生於阿瓜杜爾塞。他擔任過多項公職：1904年任國民公會代表，1905至1906年任巴拿馬城財務官，1908年任國家財政部副部長，1909至1914年任國家銀行經理；1910年當選第三順位總統代理人，1912年曾短暫接掌行政權；1914年任政府與司法部長，1922年被任命為電報局總局長。
body.en: According to the encyclopedia entry, Chiari was born on 15 November 1870 in Aguadulce. He held many government posts: deputy to the National Convention in 1904, treasurer of Panama City in 1905–1906, deputy secretary of the treasury in 1908 and manager of the national bank in 1909–1914. In 1910 he was elected third designate to the presidency and in 1912 briefly took charge of the executive office; in 1914 he became secretary of government and justice, and in 1922 he was appointed director general of the telegraph service.

body.zh-Hant: 條目稱基亞里是自由黨的重要成員，1924年當選後以偏重商業的施政取代波拉斯（Porras）的民粹作風，導致黨內爭執並終致分裂。1925年他面臨兩場危機，其一是聖布拉斯群島庫納人的叛亂，他成功平息；1926年他與美國談判新條約，但國民議會未予批准。
body.en: The entry says Chiari was a prominent Liberal Party member and, after his 1924 election, replaced Porras's populist style with a more business-oriented administration, leading to a quarrel and a split in the party. In 1925 he faced two serious crises, one of them a rebellion by the Cuna Indians on the San Blas Islands, which he quelled. In 1926 he negotiated a new treaty with the United States, but the National Assembly never ratified it.

heading.en: Birth and early career as a teacher

body.zh-Hant: 洪塞德1883年5月6日生於羅加蘭的維達爾（Vikedal）。1905年在奧斯（Ås）完成學業後，他多年擔任青年學校與農業學校教師；1915至1918年任《Eidsvoll Blad》編輯，其後出任泰勒馬克農業學校（位於 Søve）校長。
body.en: Jens Hundseid was born on 6 May 1883 in Vikedal, Rogaland. After finishing his studies at Ås in 1905 he spent several years as a teacher at folk and agricultural schools; from 1915 to 1918 he edited Eidsvoll Blad, and afterwards he became head of the Telemark agricultural school at Søve.

body.zh-Hant: 洪塞德自1920年農民黨成立起即為黨員；1926年當選該黨副主席，1929年當選黨主席，1931年當選議會黨團領袖。1932年3月14日被任命為首相，1933年3月3日辭職。
body.en: Hundseid was a member of the Farmers' Party (Bondepartiet) from its founding in 1920; he was elected its deputy chairman in 1926, chairman in 1929 and parliamentary leader in 1931. He was appointed prime minister on 14 March 1932 and resigned on 3 March 1933.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與任總統前的公職
heading.en: Origins and offices before the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 阿科斯塔1872年5月23日生。據條目，他是布勞利奧·卡里略（Braulio Carrillo）的外甥。總統任期前，他曾任1902至1906年制憲會議代表、1907年家鄉阿拉胡埃拉省省長，以及1912至1915年駐薩爾瓦多領事。
body.en: Julio Acosta García was born on 23 May 1872. The entry says he was a nephew of Braulio Carrillo. Before winning the presidency he served as delegate to the Constitutional Congress of 1902–1906, governor of his home province of Alajuela in 1907, and consul to El Salvador in 1912–1915.

As a nephew of Braulio Carrillo (president 1834–1841)

body.zh-Hant: 阿科斯塔是1920至1924年的哥斯大黎加總統，屬自由黨；他曾出兵處理與巴拿馬的邊界衝突。任期結束後獲頒多項國內外榮譽，1945年擔任哥斯大黎加出席舊金山聯合國組織會議代表團的團長。
body.en: Acosta was president of Costa Rica in 1920–1924 and a Liberal; he committed troops in a border conflict with Panama. After his term he received many national and international awards, and in 1945 he was chief of Costa Rica's delegation to the United Nations organizational meetings in San Francisco.

body.en: According to the Assemblée nationale database, Georges Leygues was born on 29 October 1856 in Villeneuve-sur-Lot (Lot-et-Garonne) and died on 2 September 1933 at Saint-Cloud. After completing his law studies he registered with the bar of his home town, and he was deputy for Lot-et-Garonne from 1885 to 1933.

body.zh-Hant: 1917年11月16日至1920年1月20日，萊格任海軍部長；1920年9月24日至1921年1月16日任部長會議主席（總理）兼外交部長；1925年11月28日至1926年7月19日及1926年7月23日至1930年2月21日再任海軍部長；1930年12月13日至1931年1月27日任內政部長；1932年6月3日至1933年9月2日又任海軍部長。
body.en: From 16 November 1917 to 20 January 1920 Leygues was Minister of the Navy; from 24 September 1920 to 16 January 1921 he was President of the Council and Minister of Foreign Affairs; he was Navy Minister again from 28 November 1925 to 19 July 1926 and from 23 July 1926 to 21 February 1930, Minister of the Interior from 13 December 1930 to 27 January 1931, and Navy Minister from 3 June 1932 to 2 September 1933.
